label: Animations
title: Animations
bodyHtml:
Animations

CUCoreLib adds support for animations. However, due to complexity of editing and viewing animations outside of the Unity editor, Unity is currently a hard requirement to make animations.

To make this easier on you, a slimmed-down unity package as well as documentation and a unity toolkit is provided.

Steps:

  1. Download the Unity package from --
  2. Open CU Modded Toolkit > Animation Workshop in the exported Unity project on the menu bar.
  3. Create a workspace pack name.
  4. Add one or more animation entries.
  5. Use Add From Template if you want a vanilla motion as a starting point, or Load Existing if you already authored custom clips elsewhere in the same Unity project.
  6. Give each entry a unique Animation Id.
  7. Assign one body clip and one arms clip to that entry.
  8. Preview the selected entry on the animated sample body in SampleScene.
  9. Create the animation using Unity's animation window.
  10. To learn how to create basic animationcurves with unity, see this video.
  11. Click Export Animation Pack Bundle.

The exported files land in CUCoreExports/AnimationPacks/. Copy the bundle file into your mod's Bundles/ folder.

How runtime playback works

Register the bundle once, then play a custom entry by id.

AssetLoader.RegisterBundleFromPluginFolder(this, "handwave.animations", "Bundles/handwave-animations");
BodyAnimationPlayer.PlayBundled(PlayerCamera.main.body, "handwave.animations", "swing_custom");

To stop custom playback forcefully via code:

BodyAnimationPlayer.ResetToVanilla(PlayerCamera.main.body);

Why is the animation's play button disabled?

If Unity's normal play button looks disabled on a raw clip, click on Animation Window.

How come there's seperate animations needed for the body and arms?

Currently, the game also has separate animation systems for the body and arms, which require distinct animation clips for each.

In order to preview both at the same time, the animation workshop provides previews for both animations together.
